content: अश्मन्तकः, -कम् .²1 A fire-place. .²2 The shade for a lamp (दीपाधार). .²3 A kind of grass. .{@-कः@} <ab>N.</ab> of several trees: - .³({%a%}) अम्लोटक; its leaf; तीराश्मन्तकशिम्बिचुम्बितमुखाः <ls>Māl. 9. 7</ls> (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>आपटा</ns>); .³({%b%}) <ab>N.</ab> of a tree कोविदारकाः (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>कोरळ</ns>); .³({%c%}) <ab>N.</ab> of a plant from the fibres of which a Brāhmaṇaʼs girdle may be made; मुञ्जालाभे तु कर्तव्या कुशाश्मन्तकबल्वजैः . <ls>Ms. 2. 43</ls>. (Monier Williams gives the word wrongly as अश्मान्तक.)
